paper_title: Counterfactual Influence as a Distributional Quantity
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the accuracy of train and validation data over epochs. The x-axis, representing epochs, has a linear scale with a range of 0 to 30 and tick labels at regular intervals of 5, with no units specified. The y-axis, representing accuracy as a percentage, also has a linear scale ranging from 40 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 10. The plot contains two lines: the blue line represents the train data and starts at approximately 47% accuracy at epoch 0, fluctuating with a peak around epoch 20 at about 95%, and ending at 98% accuracy at epoch 30; it has a solid line style and no markers. The green line represents the validation data, starting at around 47% accuracy at epoch 0, with fluctuations and a general upward trend, ending at approximately 82% accuracy at epoch 30, also with a solid line style and no markers.
